newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela mulls March gasoline price hike -paper.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela mulls March gasoline price hike -paper.

text.p: Venezuela is mulling a possible ten bolivar ($0.02), or 17 percent, gasoline price increase for later this year, according to leading national daily El Universal.

While the final decision rests with President Rafael Caldera, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said the increase would compensate for rising production costs due to over 100 percent inflation last year. The hike could come before June, El Universal reported.
The rise would follow a fivefold rise in domestic gasoline prices in mid-April, part of the country's stiff package of economic reforms.
